notes.title: Aug 8 - Major update!
notes.content:
[h1]Aug 8, 2025. Major update![/h1]

[h2]New character model[/h2]
We now have a new character model which also comes with new animations. We now show the direction a player is walking perfectly with 8-direction sprite. There is also now a unique animation for running, as well as swinging your weapon.

[h2]Safe zones[/h2]
Safe zones are now added! these are in a basic state at the moment, but will be improved upon. These zones do not guarantee safety but they have guards that will help clear zombies and a wall all around that helps keep zombies out.

[h2]Missions[/h2]
There are now missions that can be claimed and completed for extra XP. You find these from the mission man NPC in safe zones.

[h2]Karma[/h2]
Karma has been added, currently this does not affect gamepleay, but it will in the future. Doing good deeds gives you positive karma ... Try killing another player and you will see what happens to your Karma ...

notes.title: (June 30) - Many big changes!
notes.content:
[b]Update Notes - [June 30][/b]

[b]What's New:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]Day/Night Cycle:[/b]
The game now has a dynamic day/night cycle, previously it was only night.

[*][b]Dual Item Equipping:[/b]
You can now equip two items and easily switch between them. Keep your melee weapon handy and quickly swap to a firearm when needed (or pickles if you prefer)

[*][b]Collisions:[/b]
Walls now block player movement. You can't walk through house walls anymore.

[*][b]Projectile and Melee Collision:[/b]
Bullets and melee attacks now collide with trees and walls. You can't shoot or strike enemies through solid objects anymore.
[/list]

notes.title: F&F Alpha update!
notes.content:
This update brings a bunch of improvements, fixes, and new features:

[h2]Bug Fixes & Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed various miscellaneous bugs
[*]Improved overall performance for smoother gameplay
[/list]

[h2]Combat Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Fixed hitbox issues in PvP for more accurate and fair combat
[*]Fixed a bug where noise from weapons would cancel out if moving
[*]Fixed a bug where you could kill someone who was already dead causing their respawn screen to show again
[/list]

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*][b]Leaderboard[/b] – Compete and see how you rank against other players
[*][b]Perk Tree[/b] – Customize your character with powerful new abilities
[/list]

[b]First round of alpha testing is starting now in a few hours at june 1st 00:00 CET[/b]
See soon 🧟‍♂️
